messages:
maria: quick sync — i want to propose a compact mapping for response signals we display in the console and expose via SDK for client UX. keeping it small helps signal-to-noise.
ajay: curious — do you mean HTTP codes only or our internal buckets too? :thinking:
maria: both. idea: keep 4 surface buckets: malformed, semantic, conflict, overloaded. map to 400, 422, 409, 429 respectively. simple labels in console: BAD_REQUEST / INVALID_INPUT / CONFLICT / THROTTLED.
sylvia: i like the simplicity. question: where do auth errors go (401/403)? separate axis? rbac problems should be AUTHN / AUTHZ not part of the 4 you listed.
maria: yep — auth stays separate. only user-input and infra flow in that palette. we also need a telemetry tag to connect console badges to metrics: proposal `response.bucket` values: ["bad_request","invalid_input","conflict","throttled","auth"]
ajay: can we keep them stable across rollouts? if we rename buckets later it will break dashboards. need versioning on the tag, like `response.bucket_v1`.
rachel: +1 to versioning. but also keep human-readable `response.hint` for client SDKs (short string) and `response.code` for numeric http.
tom: concern: some clients expect 400 for all input problems; 422 is less common. are we okay teaching them 422? i know some languages/libraries don't treat 422 specially.
sylvia: we can add SDK glue: SDKs should coerce 422->InvalidInputError with the hint attached. doc snippets and migration guide included in rollout.
ops-bot: deploy:console-badges v0.3 -> staging at 2024-04-12T14:12:10Z
maria: rollout plan: 1) emit new telemetry keys with `_v1` suffix while still sending the old ones for 30d. 2) console shows both but prefers v1 for UI. 3) SDKs read v1 if present else fallback.
ajay: will we add sample payloads in API docs? i can draft examples for common validation failures — e.g.
ajay: ```json
HTTP/1.1 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "code": 422,
  "error": "invalid_input",
  "hint": "prompt too long (max 2048 tokens)",
  "details": [{"field":"prompt","problem":"length_exceeded"}]
}
```
rachel: good. also include a short `retryable` flag for clients for things that are safe to retry (throttle only). helps SDK backoff logic.
mar ia: (typo) maria: +1 on `retryable` but default false. we should only set true for server-side transients like 429/503.
tom: for console badging, can we show consequence-level coloring? invalid_input = amber, conflict = orange, throttled = red? maybe keep palette aligned with severity.
sylvia: prefer: invalid_input = amber (low), conflict = orange (medium), throttled = red (high). add tooltip copy that maps to suggested developer action.
ajay: telemetry side: add `response.action_suggested` field (enum) with values like `fix_input`, `retry_with_backoff`, `check_quota`, `contact-support`.
rachel: one more: i18n strings for tooltips — put keys in the payload metadata like `ui.tooltip_key`: "response.invalid_input.prompt_length" so console can fetch localized copy.
ops-bot: alert: noticed increased 429s in eu-west-1 last hour — rolling throttles triggered.
maria: ok ops note — we'll mark that bucket as `throttled` in console and surface a runbook link (`ui.runbook: /runbooks/throttling`).
tom: final ask: add a short migration doc and a small eval to ensure we don't accidentally surface PII in `hint` or `details`. security wants `details` sanitized.
sylvia: i can own the migration doc. i'll also add a lint rule in the server that strips anything matching email/ssn patterns from `hint` and `details`.
ajay: timeline: draft PR for telemetry + SDK change by EOD Friday, console PR next Wed, canary rollout next Thursday.
maria: thanks team. i'll post a short RFC with these buckets and examples after the PRs. :thumbsup:
